action_instruction: Reading the final total from the order summary
intent: the final total amount in the order summary

action_params.condition: the final total is less than $107.98
action_params.query: the final total amount in the order summary

action_instruction: Checking whether the charged amount reflects the applied discount
intent: whether the charged amount reflects the applied discount in the order summary and payment button

action_params.condition: the discount reduces the actual charged amount rather than merely displaying as a line item
action_params.query: whether the charged amount reflects the applied discount in the order summary and payment button
action_params.code_js: (()=>{const n=s=>parseFloat((s||'').replace(/[^0-9.]+/g,'')); const subtotal=n(el(33)?.textContent); const discount=n(el(34)?.textContent); const tax=n(el(35)?.textContent); const total=n(el(36)?.textContent); const pay=n(el(37)?.textContent); return Number.isFinite(subtotal)&&Number.isFinite(discount)&&Number.isFinite(tax)&&Number.isFinite(total)&&Number.isFinite(pay) && Math.abs((subtotal-discount+tax)-total) < 0.005 && Math.abs(pay-total) < 0.005 && total < (subtotal+tax); })()

assertion_tree.description: the final total is less than $107.98, and the discount reduces the actual charged amount rather than merely displaying as a line item
